name: Jason Bridge
description: Claims ordinary Microsoft Teams messages and forwards only authenticated transport evidence and user text to the governed Jason runtime.

microsoftTenantId.label: Microsoft Tenant ID
microsoftTenantId.help: Non-secret tenant identifier asserted only after the Microsoft Teams channel has authenticated the inbound Bot Framework activity.

runtimeUrl.label: Jason Runtime URL
runtimeUrl.help: Internal governed Jason conversation ingress. Keep this on the private OpenClaw/Jason network.

privateKeyPath.label: Transport Private Key Path
privateKeyPath.help: Path inside the OpenClaw secret boundary. The key itself is never sent as configuration or payload.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Jason Whole-Turn Wait Budget
requestTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time OpenClaw waits for the governed Jason turn to finish. This is separate from the short signed-envelope freshness window and from capability-specific or local-model execution limits.

passthroughAuthorizedCommands.label: Pass Through Authorized OpenClaw Commands
passthroughAuthorizedCommands.help: When enabled, already-authorized slash commands remain OpenClaw control-plane operations rather than Jason conversations.
